name: contrast-picker
title: Contrast Picker
description: Shows the WCAG 2 contrast ratio truncated, never rounded up (#777 on white is 4.47:1 and fails), with AA/AAA marks for normal and large text, and a one-tap nearest passing colour that changes only lightness so the hue stays on brand.

meta.summary: Shows the WCAG contrast ratio of a text and background pair, never rounded up, and offers the nearest passing colour, so unreadable text doesn't ship.
catches: Ratios just under a threshold that rounding would hide (4.499 shown as 4.49, a fail)
Failures for normal text versus large text, at AA and AAA
A nearest passing colour that keeps the hue
limits: Uses the WCAG 2 formula; it is not an APCA (WCAG 3 draft) checker
Checks solid colours only, not text over images, gradients or transparency
Readability also depends on font weight and size, which it does not measure
a11y: Labelled colour fields with aria-invalid on unreadable values; swatches have aria-labels
The ratio has an aria-label ("Contrast ratio 4.47 to 1")
Pass/fail is written in words ("fails, needs 4.5:1") plus icons

rules.note: Informational. Checked thresholds: AA 4.5:1 normal / 3:1 large; AAA 7:1 normal / 4.5:1 large.
